metadata.title: Candid Interior Car Portrait with External Observers

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, cinematic interior car shot featuring a central figure interacting with a crowd peering through the windows, characterized by deep shadows and rich textures.
triggerTerms: cinematic flash photography with film grain
excludeWhen: outdoor landscapes without a vehicle focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A claustrophobic yet intimate scene set inside a vintage car, where a man in a textured knit sweater is surrounded by onlookers pressing against the glass, captured with a harsh flash that emphasizes skin texture and deep red upholstery.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in profile vs. frontal faces in windows
Deep red interior vs. bright exterior light
Coarse knit texture vs. smooth leather and glass
coreInvariants: High-contrast flash lighting with deep fall-off
Visible film grain and analog color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is seated on the right, occupying the midground at a medium scale, facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hands and the notepad he is holding serve as the central point of action.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the faces in the windows on the left, follows their gaze to the subject on the right, and then down to the foreground leg.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black shadows in the lower left and deep red shadows in the car ceiling provide negative space.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool blue and white (exterior sky and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright exterior and the dark interior, with saturated warm tones in the skin and upholstery.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian typeface for advisory labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, modern, and dense typographic block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic 35mm film photo of a man in a yellow and grey knit sweater sitting inside a vintage car with red velvet interior. Several children are looking through the car windows from the outside. Use high-contrast flash lighting and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, white rectangular block in the bottom right corner containing bold, black, condensed sans-serif text stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?
Are the faces outside the window clearly visible but slightly darker than the interior subject?
Is the film grain texture present across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Number of people outside the window
mustRedesign: Specific text content of the advisory label

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in clothing and upholstery

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic skin textures under flash
Ensure the red interior tones are rich and not washed out
Verify the perspective of the people looking through the glass is anatomically correct
Confirm the grain is not digitally noisy but looks like film emulsion
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Flash Interior + [Subject Description] + [Crowd Interaction] + Red Velvet/Leather Textures + 35mm Film Grain
